name: csv_sculptor
description: Draft schemas for a future CSV Sculptor Agent transport. This repository does not ship an MCP server or tool registration.

tools.name: csv_sculptor_parse
tools.description: Parse a CSV/TSV string into a structured table. Auto-detects delimiter (comma, tab, pipe, semicolon) and optionally detects whether the first row is a header.

input.description: Raw CSV/TSV text content to parse.

has_header.description: Whether the first row should be treated as a header. Set to false to auto-detect.

tools.name: csv_sculptor_filter
tools.description: Apply one or more filter conditions to a CsvTable. All conditions must match (AND logic). Supports 9 operators: Equals, NotEquals, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, GreaterThan, LessThan, IsEmpty, IsNotEmpty.

conditions_json.description: JSON array of filter conditions, each with 'column', 'operator', and optional 'value'.

tools.name: csv_sculptor_sort
tools.description: Sort a CsvTable by a specified column, ascending or descending. Numeric columns are sorted by numeric value; text columns lexicographically.

ascending.description: Sort direction: true for ascending, false for descending.

tools.name: csv_sculptor_export
tools.description: Export a CsvTable to a specified format. Supported formats: json, yaml, markdown, sql, csv, tsv.

table_name.description: Table name used for SQL INSERT format.

tools.name: csv_sculptor_detect_delimiter
tools.description: Detect the delimiter character used in a CSV/TSV string. Returns one of: comma (,), tab (\t), pipe (|), or semicolon (;).

input.description: Raw CSV/TSV text content to analyze.
